## Introduction

The goal of this project is to perform of a statistical analysis of a High-Fidelity Simulation Aerodynamics Dataset of NACA 0012 and 0021 airfoils. The primary goal of this project is to evaluate how geometric thickness (NACA 0012 vs. NACA 0021) and flow conditions interact to influence load vector fluctuations. If this is completed, an additional analysis will be done to evaluate how simulation mesh resolution (coarse, medium, fine) of NACA 0021 affects prediction error.



```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

```

## Data Imports

```{r}
# Base folder paths matching your Windows directory structure
folder_0021 <- "NACA0021/NACA0021"
folder_0012 <- "NACA0012/NACA0012"
folder_0012_exp <- "NACA0012/NACA0012/exp_data"

# NACA 0021 CFD Files (6 files: Re = 270k and 2000k at AOA = 5, 45, 60)
aoa2705  <- read.table(file.path(folder_0021, "Re_270k_aoa_5.dat"),   header = TRUE)
aoa27045 <- read.table(file.path(folder_0021, "Re_270k_aoa_45.dat"),  header = TRUE)
aoa27060 <- read.table(file.path(folder_0021, "Re_270k_aoa_60.dat"),  header = TRUE)

aoa2005  <- read.table(file.path(folder_0021, "Re_2000k_aoa_5.dat"),  header = TRUE)
aoa20045 <- read.table(file.path(folder_0021, "Re_2000k_aoa_45.dat"), header = TRUE)
aoa20060 <- read.table(file.path(folder_0021, "Re_2000k_aoa_60.dat"), header = TRUE)

# NACA 0012 CFD Files from Subdirectories (6 files at AOA = 5, 45, 60; Re = 2000k)
# Fine Mesh Tier (251 wall-normal, 121 spanwise)
n12_fine_aoa5  <- read.table(file.path(folder_0012, "aoa_5",  "iddes-sou-234-251-121-v2.dat"), header = TRUE)
n12_fine_aoa45 <- read.table(file.path(folder_0012, "aoa_45", "iddes-sou-234-251-121-v2.dat"), header = TRUE)
n12_fine_aoa60 <- read.table(file.path(folder_0012, "aoa_60", "iddes-sou-234-251-121-v2.dat"), header = TRUE)

# Medium Mesh Tier (143 wall-normal, 96 spanwise)
n12_med_aoa5   <- read.table(file.path(folder_0012, "aoa_5",  "iddes-sou-234-143-96-v2.dat"),  header = TRUE)
n12_med_aoa45  <- read.table(file.path(folder_0012, "aoa_45", "iddes-sou-234-143-96-v2.dat"),  header = TRUE)
n12_med_aoa60  <- read.table(file.path(folder_0012, "aoa_60", "iddes-sou-234-143-96-v2.dat"),  header = TRUE)

# Experimental Wind Tunnel Polars
exp_n21_cd_270k  <- read.csv(file.path(folder_0021, "cd_exp_data_Re_270k.txt"), header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", "Cd_exp"))
exp_n21_cl_270k  <- read.csv(file.path(folder_0021, "cl_exp_data_Re_270k.txt"), header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", "Cl_exp"))
exp_n21_cd_2000k <- read.csv(file.path(folder_0021, "cd_exp_data_2000k.txt"),   header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", "Cd_exp"))
exp_n21_cl_2000k <- read.csv(file.path(folder_0021, "cl_exp_data_2000k.txt"),   header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", "Cl_exp"))

exp_n12_cd_sheldahl <- read.csv(file.path(folder_0012_exp, "cd_exp_data_sheldahl.txt"), header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", "Cd_exp"))
exp_n12_cl_sheldahl <- read.csv(file.path(folder_0012_exp, "cl_exp_data_sheldahl.txt"), header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", "Cl_exp"))
```

## Data Tidying

```{r}
## Data Tidying

cfd_tidy <- bind_rows(
  # NACA 0021 (6 files: Re = 270k & 2000k, Fine Mesh [251-121])
  aoa2705 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k",  AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa27045 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k",  AOA = 45, Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa27060 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k",  AOA = 60, Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa2005 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k", AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa20045 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k", AOA = 45, Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa20060 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k", AOA = 60, Mesh = "Fine"),
  
  # NACA 0012 (6 files: Fine & Medium Meshes at Re = 2000k)
  n12_fine_aoa5  |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_fine_aoa45 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 45, Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_fine_aoa60 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 60, Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_med_aoa5   |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Medium"),
  n12_med_aoa45  |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 45, Mesh = "Medium"),
  n12_med_aoa60  |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 60, Mesh = "Medium")
) |>
  mutate(
    Airfoil = factor(Airfoil, levels = c("NACA 0012", "NACA 0021")),
    Re = factor(Re, levels = c("270k", "2000k")),
    AOA_fac = factor(sprintf("%d°", AOA), levels = c("5°", "45°", "60°")),
    Mesh = factor(Mesh, levels = c("Medium", "Fine")),
    Config = sprintf("%s (Re=%s, %s)", Airfoil, Re, Mesh)
  )
```

## Aerodynamics Adjustment and Analysis

```{r}
# Reference scaling factor (Dynamic Pressure * Planform Area)
q_inf_A <- 5750.0

# Compute aerodynamic force vectors, skin friction ratios, and filter out startup transient
cfd_aero <- cfd_tidy |>
  filter(Time >= 0.25) |>
  mutate(
    aoa_rad  = AOA * pi / 180,
    # Total Cartesian Force Vectors (F_x, F_y)
    F_x = Fpx + Fvx,
    F_y = Fpy + Fvy,
    Fx_total = F_x,
    Fy_total = F_y,
    # Pressure and Viscous Force Magnitudes & Skin Friction Ratio
    Fp_mag = sqrt(Fpx^2 + Fpy^2),
    Fv_mag = sqrt(Fvx^2 + Fvy^2),
    Skin_Friction_Ratio_Mag = Fv_mag / (Fp_mag + Fv_mag),
    # Rotate Cartesian forces into freestream Drag and Lift (Newtons)
    Drag_N =  F_x * cos(aoa_rad) + F_y * sin(aoa_rad),
    Lift_N = -F_x * sin(aoa_rad) + F_y * cos(aoa_rad),
    # Non-dimensionalize into aerodynamic coefficients
    Cd = Drag_N / q_inf_A,
    Cl = Lift_N / q_inf_A
  )

aero_summary <- cfd_aero |>
  group_by(Airfoil, Re, AOA, AOA_fac, Mesh) |>
  summarize(
    Mean_Fx = mean(F_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Fy = mean(F_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Skin_Ratio = mean(Skin_Friction_Ratio_Mag, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Cl = mean(Cl, na.rm = TRUE),
    Var_Cl = var(Cl, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Cl = sd(Cl, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Cd = mean(Cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    Var_Cd = var(Cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Cd = sd(Cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Mz = mean(Mtz, na.rm = TRUE),
    Var_Mz = var(Mtz, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_Steps = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

glimpse(aero_summary)
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis Plots

```{r}
# Reshape F_x and F_y for multi-panel time-series visualization
cfd_aero |>
  filter(Mesh == "Fine") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(F_x, F_y), names_to = "Force_Vector", values_to = "Force_N") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Force_N, color = interaction(Airfoil, Re, sep = " | Re="))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(AOA_fac ~ Force_Vector, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Time-Series Histories of Total Force Vectors (F_x and F_y)",
    subtitle = "Comparison across Airfoil Geometry, Reynolds Number, and Angle of Attack (Fine Mesh)",
    x = "Simulation Time (s)",
    y = "Total Force (N)",
    color = "Configuration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Density Distribution Curves of Total Normal Force (F_y)
cfd_aero |>
  filter(Mesh == "Fine") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = F_y, fill = interaction(Airfoil, Re, sep = " | Re="), color = interaction(Airfoil, Re, sep = " | Re="))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ AOA_fac, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Distribution Curves of Total Normal Force (F_y)",
    subtitle = "Demonstrating narrow unimodal distributions at 5° vs. broad, vortex-shedding distributions at 45° and 60°",
    x = "Total Force Vector F_y (N)",
    y = "Probability Density",
    fill = "Airfoil & Re",
    color = "Airfoil & Re"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Commparison of Pressure vs. Viscous Force Magnitudes
cfd_aero |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Fp_mag, y = Fv_mag, color = Config)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ AOA_fac, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(
  n.breaks = 4,
  labels   = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k"))+
  labs(
    title = "Pressure Force (||F_p||) vs. Viscous Skin Friction Force (||F_v||)",
    subtitle = "Phase distribution across all 12 simulation cases partitioned by Angle of Attack",
    x = "Resultant Pressure Force Magnitude ||F_p|| (N)",
    y = "Resultant Viscous Force Magnitude ||F_v|| (N)",
    color = "Dataset Configuration"
  ) + theme_minimal()



# Skin Friction Ratio comparison across Angles of Attack
cfd_aero |>
  ggplot(aes(x = AOA_fac, y = Skin_Friction_Ratio_Mag * 100, fill = Config)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Skin Friction Contribution Ratio Across Angles of Attack (Log-Scale)",
    subtitle = "Percentage of total aerodynamic load attributable to viscous shear stress: ||F_v|| / (||F_p|| + ||F_v||)",
    x = "Angle of Attack",
    y = "Skin Friction Ratio (%) [Log_10 Scale]") + theme_minimal()
```
